request: Recommencer completement avec une autre scene culte, plus realiste.
prompt:
Generate a completely NEW Barret Wallace illustration for Kalistar x Final Fantasy VII. References: image 1 is the approved original Barret, use it for character likeness, clothing, anatomy, gun-prosthesis materials and painting style only. Image 2 is approved Aeris, use it for the Kalistar hand-painted art direction and heartfelt emotional storytelling only. Do not copy either pose or background.

NEW ICONIC SCENE: BARRET AND MARLENE REUNITED AT SEVENTH HEAVEN. An intimate, unforgettable father-daughter moment in the modest Sector 7 bar, after Barret returns from a dangerous mission. The huge tough Barret is seated on a sturdy low wooden bench, three-quarter toward us, leaning slightly forward as little Marlene throws her arms around his neck. She nestles against his HUMAN LEFT shoulder on the image right. He cradles her gently with his LEFT human hand spread protectively across the back of her head. His familiar rugged face is clearly visible in three-quarter view, looking lovingly at her: genuinely tender relieved smile, softened brows, slightly moist eyes. This giant warrior briefly lets his guard down. Marlene, a small child in her recognizable simple white top and pink pinafore, dark brown hair, looks safe and joyful with eyes half closed in the hug. Innocent family affection, moving and understated rather than sugary. No battle scream and no theatrical grimace. The hug and Barret's expression are the focal point.

BARRET MUST BE RECOGNIZABLE: powerful very muscular stocky Black man, dark brown skin, short flat-top haircut, dense short beard, forehead/cheek scar details, sunglasses pushed up onto forehead so we see eyes, worn brown sleeveless vest over black shirt, dog tags, olive cargo trousers and heavy boots. Preserve original reference character design. His RIGHT forearm is a believable compact industrial rotary GUN PROSTHESIS, not a handheld weapon. It is at rest, lowered beside his own right knee toward lower-middle-left of the picture, safely away from Marlene, muzzle pointing to the floor. Render a mechanically coherent proportional forearm-sized receiver and straight exposed parallel steel barrels. Show recognizable barrel length and muzzle but DO NOT make an enormously long tower or a giant cannon. No smoke, firing, flash or threat. One human left hand, one gun prosthesis on right forearm; do not add a right human hand. Marlene has two normal child arms around his neck. Keep all limbs legible and coherent.

COMPOSITION FOR A CARD: portrait 4:5. Three-quarter seated view from just below knees to above head, not a distant full-room scene. Main face around x=48%, y=25%; child's face around x=63%, y=29%. Both faces and the hug inside the middle 60% of the canvas, not clipped by edges. Keep lowered cannon visibly inside x=27%-43%, y=54%-80%, with a plain warm-light backdrop behind its dark silhouette; the outer 18% on each side may be covered by card stat columns. Keep the small child on his human-arm side, no overlapping mechanical limb. Barret dominates the frame without the child hiding his face. Make the gun and affection simultaneously readable.

SETTING: warmly lit worn Seventhh Heaven bar, intimate rather than crowded. A softly painted battered wooden counter, a few mismatched glasses and bottles, an old stool, subtle pipes and corrugated walls glimpsed through a window, one warm lamp, cool evening outside. Leave the background QUIET and simplified with broad painterly shapes; no dense clutter, no crowds, no legible signage, no invented logos. Amber interior light and cool blue-gray evening, weathered mahogany/red accents, light caressing faces and hand. The air of a humble home people fight to protect.

STRICT KALISTAR DA: emotionally expressive detailed narrative fantasy PAINTING with visible confident brushwork, painted faceted color planes, selective edges, weathered tactile leather/metal/wood. Match Aeris and Barret references exactly as one illustrated universe, no anime, no manga, no smooth CGI or 3D-render look, no photorealism or movie screenshot. No synthetic uniform noise. High craft, anatomically believable, no awkward doll child. Illustration only, absolutely no card border, UI, numbers, lettering, text, watermark or graphic panels.
